title: OmniVia Core Application Contract v1 - common types
description: Provider-neutral scalar and value types shared by the compatibility, error, and envelope schemas. This document declares no root type; it is a definition container only.

ContractVersion.title: ContractVersion
ContractVersion.description: A `major.minor` contract version. Major changes are breaking; minor changes are additive and forward compatible.

ReleaseVersion.title: ReleaseVersion
ReleaseVersion.description: A SemVer 2.0.0 release string identifying a concrete build, not a contract.

RequestId.title: RequestId
RequestId.description: Bounded, non-empty caller-assigned identifier for a single request attempt.

CorrelationId.title: CorrelationId
CorrelationId.description: Bounded, non-empty identifier grouping related requests into one logical operation.

TraceId.title: TraceId
TraceId.description: Bounded, non-empty distributed-trace identifier. Diagnostic only; never an authorization input.

WorkspaceId.title: WorkspaceId
WorkspaceId.description: Bounded, non-empty identifier of the workspace a request is scoped to.

AuditReference.title: AuditReference
AuditReference.description: Bounded, non-empty server-issued reference to the audit record for a completed operation.

Identifier.title: Identifier
Identifier.description: Generic bounded, non-empty identifier used for clients, principals, roles, and deprecations.

CapabilityId.title: CapabilityId
CapabilityId.description: Stable namespaced capability identifier such as `memory.read`. At least one dot is required so capability names always carry a namespace.

OpenCode.title: OpenCode
OpenCode.description: An open, lowercase, dot-namespaced code. Unknown values are valid by design so that compatible minor releases can add vocabulary; consumers must preserve values they do not recognize.

Scope.title: Scope
Scope.description: An open scope token such as `memory:read` requested by the caller. Scopes narrow a request; they never widen granted authority.

Purpose.title: Purpose
Purpose.description: An open purpose-limitation token stating why the caller is making this request.

OpaqueToken.title: OpaqueToken
OpaqueToken.description: A bounded, server-issued opaque token. Clients must round-trip it verbatim and must never parse it.

IdempotencyKey.title: IdempotencyKey
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-assigned key making a mutation safe to retry. Equal keys with different inputs are an `idempotency_conflict`.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a literal `Z` offset.

DurationMs.title: DurationMs
DurationMs.description: A bounded non-negative duration in milliseconds.

ProjectionVersion.title: ProjectionVersion
ProjectionVersion.description: An opaque per-projection version marker used to reason about read staleness.

JsonObject.title: JsonObject
JsonObject.description: An opaque JSON object. The application contract carries domain payloads without inspecting them; per-operation payload schemas are out of scope for v1 foundations.

ClientIdentity.title: ClientIdentity
ClientIdentity.description: Self-declared identity of the calling client. Diagnostic and compatibility input only; never an authorization input.

PrincipalClaim.title: PrincipalClaim
PrincipalClaim.description: UNTRUSTED. A claim made by the caller about who it is acting as. Authentication credentials stay transport-owned; a principal claim never becomes a GrantedAuthority without server-side validation.

claimed_principal_id.description: Principal the caller claims to act as. Unvalidated.

claimed_roles.description: Roles the caller claims to hold. Unvalidated.

GrantedAuthority.title: GrantedAuthority
GrantedAuthority.description: Server-produced, validated authority actually applied to a request. This is the only authority statement a client may trust.

principal_id.description: Validated principal the operation executed as.

roles.description: Validated roles held by the principal.

capabilities.description: Capability references actually granted for this request.

MutationPrecondition.title: MutationPrecondition
MutationPrecondition.description: Optimistic-concurrency precondition for a mutation. A mismatch is a `mutation_precondition_failed` error.

record_version.description: Opaque version of the record the caller intends to modify.

Warning.title: Warning
Warning.description: A non-fatal advisory attached to a successful or failed response.

code.description: Open warning code. Unknown codes must be preserved and surfaced, not dropped.

message.description: Human-readable warning text. Not a stable interface.

Omission.title: Omission
Omission.description: A statement that something the caller asked for was deliberately not returned.

path.description: Optional JSON Pointer into the result identifying what was omitted.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Not a stable interface.

PartialResult.title: PartialResult
PartialResult.description: Marks a result as incomplete. A partial result is still a success; callers must not treat it as a full answer.

is_partial.description: True when the result is known to be incomplete.

reasons.description: Open codes explaining why the result is partial.

ProjectionFreshness.title: ProjectionFreshness
ProjectionFreshness.description: Staleness statement for reads served from a projection rather than the write model. Every projection this read was served from must be named in both `projection_versions` and `projection_watermarks`: the two maps are one statement about the same set of projections, so their key sets are required to be identical and neither may be empty. A read served from no named projection cannot state its own staleness, and a projection that states a version but no watermark (or the reverse) leaves the caller unable to tell how far behind the write model it actually is.

as_of.description: Point in time the projection reflects.

projection_versions.description: Open map of projection name to the opaque projection version this read was actually served from. Projection names are an open vocabulary, so new projections may appear in compatible minor releases; at least one must be named, and the key set must equal `projection_watermarks`'.

projection_watermarks.description: Open map of projection name to the opaque write-model version each projection has consumed up to -- how far the projection has caught up, as opposed to which version served this read. Keyed by exactly the same projection names as `projection_versions`; at least one must be named.

stale.description: True when the server knows the projection lags the write model.

PageLimit.title: PageLimit
PageLimit.description: A bounded positive page size a caller requests for a paginated read.

PageMetadata.title: PageMetadata
PageMetadata.description: Pagination position. Token issuance semantics are deliberately out of scope for v1 foundations.

continuation_token.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Absent means the last page.

JobReference.title: JobReference
JobReference.description: Reference to asynchronous work started by an operation. Job lifecycle, polling, and cancellation are later phases; v1 carries the identifier only.
